items.body: Ten years is a long time to leave a monster in the basement, especially when you know it has been down there learning new tricks. Ghosts In The Graveyard return to their 2016 debut, Monsters For The Masses, with the zeal of directors who finally found the budget they wanted the first time around. Monsters For The Masses: Resurrected tears into the old recordings with fresh programming, heavier production, electronic detail, and the accumulated bad habits of a band that has spent a decade getting better at making darkness dance. The real kick comes from hearing Byron C. Miller’s younger self dragged into the present without sanding away the cheap-horror charm. Miller had just come out of eight years with God Module when the original record took shape, and you can still feel a frontman figuring out how much theater, electronics, guitar damage, and personal debris he could cram into his own clubhouse. “This album means the world to me,” gushes Miller. “After 8 years in God Module, this was the first music project I put together, the first time I was writing most of the lyrics, defining the aesthetic. The interludes on this album are made from cassette recordings I did when I was a little kid trying to be scary. In many ways these songs are the first half of my life as song. I’m so glad that my bandmate, music creator, Paul Morgan, was able to take everything he’s learned and go in and rebuild these tracks from the original recordings. I love how these new mixes were mastered by our pal, Chris Longo. This is how the album was always meant to sound!” Directed by Byron C. Miller and shot by cinematographer Paul Morgan, the Monster Mask video follows an eerie little vignette in which a woman’s peace is abruptly disturbed. We’ll leave the rest of the plot buried where it belongs, since spoiling horror is the cultural equivalent of telling somebody what is inside the coffin before they pry it open. One practical warning, however: the video contains extensive flashing lights, so viewers with photosensitivity should approach accordingly. Watch the video for Monster Mask: Resurrected below: Ghosts In The Graveyard know horror works best when somebody is having too much fun with it. “Better In Black: Resurrected Version” comes back with its teeth filed to fresh points, Paul Morgan rebuilding the track from the original masters while preserving the sleazy romantic pull that made it central to the band’s identity. Monster Mask: Resurrected Version sinks lower and stranger, bringing dark trip-hop tension into the graveyard. Then there is Debonair, the sole new recording, a cover of The Afghan Whigs that gives the project its best excuse for existing beyond anniversary bookkeeping. It has the heat of a band testing an old skeleton under stage lights, turning the album into a current document with ten years of dirt under its fingernails. Ghosts In The Graveyard still love blood, monsters, desire, death, and all the lurid furniture, yet the stronger point is how seriously they take the pleasure of performance. Resurrection becomes vandalism with better equipment, a chance to exhume their younger selves, hand them louder machinery, and see what starts moving. Listen to Monster Mask: Resurrected below and purchase the single here. Monsters for the Masses : Resurrected by Ghosts In The Graveyard Follow Ghosts In The Graveyard: Instagram YouTube Bandcamp The post Ghosts In The Graveyard Dig Up Their Debut for “Monsters For The Masses: Resurrected” — Watch the Video for “Monster Mask” appeared first on Post-Punk.com.
items._cn_summary: 这张专辑是乐队2016年首作的重制版本，制作人Paul Morgan对原始录音进行了重新编程与混音，加入了更厚重的电子制作与细节，保留了主唱Byron C. Miller早年脱离God Module后那种剧场化、个人化的哥特恐怖美学。专辑中穿插了Miller童年时用磁带录制的恐怖声音素材作为间奏，使整张作品带有强烈的自传色彩。重制版对原有曲目做了从trip-hop张力到sleazy浪漫气质的不同方向重塑，并额外收录了一首The Afghan Whigs的翻唱作品，展现了乐队十年来的成长。重制概念虽有意义，但本质上是旧素材的再加工而非全新创作，创新性有限，但对于暗潮与后朋克场景的乐迷来说，重制后的声音细节与制作深度值得一听。

items.body: I didn't really like Holocene. I could, however, appreciate it. That distinction is important: while the album wasn't for me, I could see what The Ocean were trying to do with it. More than that, I accepted that experimentation and change was the entire point of the project. Hell, Pelagial (still my favorite album from the band) is built around the very idea of change and transformation. But the direction the band was going in wasn't for me; I didn't think they executed it with enough skill to hold my interest. And so, I approached Solaris with some trepidation. I knew what to expect, namely something different, especially when I heard that four new band members were being added. What form would The Ocean take this time? Would some of the "old" sound return and, more importantly I think, did I want it to?Well, the answer to both of those questions is "sort of". Solaris is definitely more akin to Pelagial and Phanerozoic than Holocene was. It has plenty of electronic sounds and touches to it but it very much revolves around some of the tried and true elements of The Ocean, namely post-metal built around a concept album. But there are also differences. As you might be able to tell from looking at the cover art, Solaris is a "brighter" album. What do I mean by that? First, the compositions are less organized around crushing force and more around exploration and melody. Even Phanerozoic, which wasn't explicitly built around the concept of weight like Pelagial was, used its instruments to oppress and crush. But Solaris has a whole gamut of new sounds; check out "Light Pollution" for example and the undulating, mercurial segment around the four minute mark and especially the exquisite guitar bridge around four minutes and fifty seconds.Have you really heard The Ocean do this in the past? Not quite. And while you're there, you probably picked up on the vocals of Lane Shi (Elizabeth Color Wheel, Fórn) who is by far the biggest new addition to this album. The Loic Rosetti style vocals, which Enrico Tiberi does an uncanny job of recreating, really benefit from having a counter-part on this release. It's not that Tiberi's voice is boring. But the interaction between his timbre and the rest of The Ocean's instruments is tried and true. Shi, on the other hand, brings a whole new texture and palette to the record, creating much of that "brightness" I was referring to earlier. Whether screaming, vocalizing, humming, or emoting she's a breath of fresh air to the record and my favorite change on it by far. Other changes include those I've already highlighted, like new ideas from new guitarists, new ideas for how tracks are "stitched" together, like the bells on "Simulacra" or the overall approach to leitmotifs and guitar riffs on the album.Speaking about "Simulacra", holy shit do I love this track. It's perhaps my favorit example of what Solaris does so well. It's definitely The Ocean but it also sounds so different, the chords chosen, the structure of the track, the synths, even what Staps does with his singing on this track. It builds up to something much more exciting than just a retread. Rather, it's a rethink, an approach to the band's past that insists not just on regurgitation but a reprocessing that results in a new approach towards the same goal and sound. Which brings me back to the question of did I want the "old" The Ocean back and my answer of "sort of". I am very happy to hear the heaviness come back to the foreground and The Ocean back to what they do well: creating meticulously constructed, concept heavy post-metal. But I am also equally happy that they did not go back to Pelagial or Phanerozoic, as much as I love those releases. I am extremely glad that they held on to what I think makes them unique and yes, what sometimes leads them to make releases I don't enjoy as much: their fierce dedication to change. You never know what The Ocean will do next and they have proven this once again on Solaris. Thankfully, the end result is also something I love.
items._cn_summary: The Ocean 在《Solaris》中延续了概念专辑框架下的后金属脉络，同时引入更明亮的音色与旋律驱动的编曲结构，弱化了以往作品中以重量感压迫听者的手法。评论特别指出电子音效、实验段落与人声互动是专辑的核心新意：新成员 Lane Shi 的多样声线为整体增添了全新质感，与原有男声形成互补。吉他段落如《Light Pollution》中四分钟左右的流畅过渡与精致桥段，以及《Simulacra》中钟声、主导动机与连缀方式的变化，被视为专辑最具新意的亮点。整体评价认可乐队持续自我革新的方向，认为专辑在保留后金属根基的同时拓展了声音边界与情感表达维度。

items.body:
Sometime in 1986, perhaps in a Paris caf�, Dominique Cravic, a singer, guitarist, and musical archivist, met Robert Crumb, an underground cartoonist, banjo and mandolin player, and jug-band aficionado. Over a few glasses of marc, to continue to speculate, they conjured up the idea for Les Primitifs du futur.  Since then, they have recorded an impossible-to-categorize series of albums, with cover illustrations by Crumb, of which Les Crimes du Mussette is the fifth.
Weird and wonderful, it sounds like they rooted through an attic full of 78 RPM records, scribbled down some arrangements, and then played them on a collection of instruments they found in another attic, including accordion, sax, xylophone, clarinet, banjo, ukulele, theremin, Hawaiian guitar, bagpipe chanter (I�m guessing here), and musical saw.
Ne tirez pas sur le pianiste (excerpt)
The 27 short tracks are mostly voiced by Cravic, who talk-sings in the manner of an everyman Maurice Chevalier. He is often accompanied by the accordion, a customary instrument in the bal-musette style that remains a strong element of the eclectic range of styles they have managed to synthesize. They also include ragtime, jug, French chanson, and, to my ears, skiffle,  just to get the list started.
Ukulele Lady (excerpt)
The liner notes point out that �Les Crimes du Musette is also a gold mine for scholars, a veritable treasure trove.� Exploring the treasures is beyond my scope here, as each tune has a long history. A highlight for me is the humorous �Ukulele Lady� from 1925, which first delighted me on Arlo Guthrie�s 1971 album
Hobo�s Lullaby
. The song has also been covered by Bing Crosby, Peter Sellers, and Bette Midler.
N'oublie pas Gr�co (excerpt)
A more serious item is �N�oublie pas Gr�co� (Don�t Forget Gr�co�)  is a tribute to the legendary chanteuse and heroine of the French Resistance, Juliette Gr�co, who died in 2020. You will also hear old chestnuts like �Fum�e aux yeux� (�Smoke Gets in Your Eyes�),  �Boude pas� (�Take Five�), and �Prive d�amour� (�As Time Goes By�).
This record is a curiosity, but it is performed by serious musicians with total commitment. In this, I was reminded of the similarly indefinable Dan Hicks & the Hot Licks. Long-forgotten music and abandoned styles are given new animation with obvious enthusiasm and care. Speaking about himself and his collaborators, many of whom are in their seventies, Dominique Cravic says, �The young have fire, but we have light.� In its own little corner,
Les Crimes du Musette
shines bright.

Vanishment
(Review)
Carolina Chocolate Drops -
Genuine Negro Jig
(Review)

items.body:
A debut, digital-only EP from a Danish trio, led by one of the Nordic folk scene�s outstanding and experienced vocalists, Mia Guldhammer. Five tracks, with the musicians bringing their own perspectives to mostly traditional music. There�s a lovely ancient, creaky mood throughout.
The opener, �Svennedal,� with its rough, cantering rhythm, offers a perfect shop window for Guldhammer�s impressive, persuasive voice, while jaw harp and bagpipes bring an insistent propulsion to �Nordg�rd,� the only original here, by band member Morten Musicus.
Cimbalom adds a delicate backdrop to the traditional �Agnete Of Bjergmanden,� with Guldhammer�s soft jaw harp offering extra textures to the other instruments, as it brings a springy opening to the final cut, �Orms�,� mingling with flute and strings to create something quite thrilling and off kilter on this instrumental.
Five tracks, and an introduction to a band that already seems very mature and accomplished. A strong beginning � what will GuldGanger do with an entire album?

items._cn_summary: 这是一张丹麦三人组合的首张数字EP，由北欧民谣圈资深歌手Mia Guldhammer领衔。五首作品大多取材自传统音乐，融合铿琴、口簧琴、风笛、锡塔尔琴、长笛与弦乐等乐器，营造出古老而略带粗粝的氛围。开场曲以奔放的节奏展示了主唱极具说服力的嗓音；唯一原创作品以口簧琴和风笛推进，动力十足；传统曲调在锡塔尔琴衬托下呈现细腻质感；终曲作为纯器乐，融合口簧琴、长笛与弦乐，产生奇妙的不对称张力。整张EP展示了乐队成熟且有完成度的声音面貌，作为引介作品颇为扎实，但从整体定位来看仍偏向传统民谣范畴，创新边界有限。

items.body: Review by kenethlevine — Sometimes a rest is as good as a change. Having disbanded after the underwhelming "Lantaloon", DANDO SHAFT resurfaced for one 1977 album with all the principals still available, though Polly doesn't sing any lead at all and is almost just there for the credits. In the meantime, a few dignitaries help expand the credit list, namely ROD CLEMENTS of LINDISFARNE and DANNY THOMPSON of PENTANGLE both on bass, as well as a fledgling saxophonist Paul Dunmall who usurps the spotlight whether it's on him or not. But is it prog? And is it good? Yes. It's that rare comeback album from the late 1970s that pleasantly surprises. It asks the "what if" question or makes the "if only" statement , in this case, could this have changed the bands fortunes if released in 1973? The rock component, notably the bluesy electric guitars and percussions, are just one aspect that elevates this above DANDO's usual twee personae, with the violins fitting like a fiddle, illuminating the mastery of "Follow You", perhaps the group's best track, and "Feel Like I wanna go home". "Trees" marks the return of the olde Englishe and Celtic credentials, even more formidably on the sophisticated "Lady and Man", If it weren't for the preponderance of average albeit absolutely competent numbers, I could give this a roundup, but it's still a miniature triumph worthy of highness if not majesty.

items._cn_summary: Dando Shaft在解散后于1977年重组，发行了这张专辑。与前作相比，乐队在原有的民谣基底上加入了蓝调电吉他、打击乐以及萨克斯等摇滚元素，并邀请了Lindisfarne的Rod Clements和Pentangle的Danny Thompson等乐手参与，使得声音比以往更为厚实多元。小提琴依然作为重要乐器贯穿始终，在《Follow You》和《Feel Like I Wanna Go Home》等曲目中展现了精湛的技艺。《Trees》和《Lady and Man》回归了英格兰与凯尔特民谣传统，后者尤为成熟。评论者认为若该专辑发行于1973年或许能改变乐队的命运，但整体仍存在部分平庸曲目，因此虽是一次小型的成功，却未能达到真正的卓越。

items.body: Review by siLLy puPPy — Touted as the French female fronted version of Porcupine Tree, the Brittany based DELUSION SQUAREDemerged in 2009 as a band that delivered much more than being a mere Steven Wilson clone. A meretrio with a larger than life sound the band was initiated by bassist / keyboardist Emmanuel de SaintM�en and multi-instrumentalist Steven Francis who would hook up with guitarist and vocalist LorraineYoung and crank out a trilogy of sci-fi themed concept albums that explored all the good BladeRunner-esque dystopia and control systems of power structures. The band released three albums withYoung who would move on before the fourth and final release came out in 2018.The band's self-titled debut and first album of the trilogy delivered an album's worth of mindbending paranoia as it incorporates the story-telling narratives inspired by neo-prog acts such asPendragon, IQ and Arena although the alternative heavy rock guitar does indeed derive inspirationfrom the prog alt rock of Porcupine Tree's early 2000s works. The music while rooted in accessibleinstantly addictive melodies also offers a grunge-fueled guitar heft that gracefully melds theworlds of smooth atmospheric embellishments with a grittier guitar gusto. While the PT referencesget tossed around quite a bit, to my ears the band at this stage reminds me more of an accessiblecrossover version of Thinking Plague if that band had eschewed the jagged angularities of avant-progand focused more on pop hooks.The album of 11 tracks is nicely spanned out with interesting intros that introduces delicate piano-based hooks and tender, even fragile sounding vocals that contrast starkly with the alternative rockon the verge of becoming metal guitar chords and riffing sessions. On the production side the albumis both smoothly polished as well as offering a nice grating edge that keeps it on both sides of thefence simultaneously in a rather elegant fashion. The tracks vary sufficiently to keep the interestlevel up and although the album sounds a little generic with the opening "The Very Day," it doesn'ttake long for its charm to burrow into your psyche and let you acclimate rather quickly into thesubtle differences that point to varying influences but sound distant enough to offer a fresh spinon the more modern take on the alt heavy rock shtick.It's actually a very pleasant mix by merging the worlds of the hard alternative rock of PorcupineTree alone with the narrative layout of neo-prog acts along with the accompanying atmospheric andkeyboard prowess. Both aspects really hold up well and despite being only a trio, the members playmultiple instruments offering a much larger band sound. Add to that the Muse inspired topics ofconspiracy, crimes against humanity and secret projects and it doesn't take long to get sucked intothe mix of it all. While lyrics rarely appeal to me, i have say that DELUSION SQUARED's debutdelivered a nicely balanced album where themes, lyrics, instrumentation and production all cometogether in a unique yet familiar manner and performed quite well by the musicians without losingthat laid back charm even when rocking the house.
items._cn_summary: DELUSION SQUARED 的同名首作是一张三人乐队编制却呈现大编制声响的跨界前卫摇滚专辑，以科幻反乌托邦叙事为框架，融合了 Porcupine Tree 式的另类摇滚吉他厚重感与 neo-prog 乐队的故事性叙事结构。专辑横跨十一首曲目，从钢琴主导的脆弱人声开篇逐步过渡到接近金属质感的吉他 riff，氛围修饰与粗粝吉他张力并存。制作层面兼具光滑打磨与粗粝边缘，乐器切换频繁，主题涉及阴谋论、反人类罪行与秘密计划。尽管旋律流畅易记、结构编排工整，但整体偏向对既有前卫摇滚传统的整合而非突破，对于追求实验性与前沿声响的听众而言，跨界幅度有限，更接近模式化的现代另类前卫摇滚作品。

items.body: The funk Isaac Hayes and Willie Hutch wrote for American crime films in the early 1970s has a second home in Hamburg, a city whose funk scene runs through The Mighty Mocambos, Bacao Rhythm & Steel Band and the Légère Recordings label. The Winston Brothers come straight out of that scene, and “Get On Down” opens their second album, Sweets, out on 6 November via Ohio’s Colemine Records. It starts at full tempo: a hard breakbeat, choppy guitar chanks and a two-man horn section. Multi-instrumentalist and producer Sebastian Nagel and drummer Lucas Kochbeck formed the band as a school project, and Nagel describes the partnership in one line: “It’s a family thing, and we really know each other well.” Both play in Bacao, Nagel has also played with the Mocambos, and Kochbeck with Hamburg Spinners, part of a circuit where the same players keep turning up in each other’s line-ups. Sweets draws on that circuit, with Kimo Eiserbeck on saxophone and flute, Hans Stephan on trumpet and Carsten Meyer, the Hamburg keyboardist known as Erobique, on synths. Extra drums come from Max Weissenfeldt, once of Munich’s The Poets of Rhythm and now working as Max Whitefield. Sax and trumpet stick to short, angular stabs, the punctuating role horns play on the Hayes and Hutch scores. Midway the band drop into a dub-style section with delay on the instrumental parts, and the drums carry on underneath: like Drift, their 2022 debut, the track is built on the break. Stream “Get On Down” HERE and order Sweets ahead of release through THIS LINK The post Daily Discovery: The Winston Brothers – Get On Down appeared first on Rhythm Passport.
items._cn_summary: 本文介绍了汉堡放克乐队The Winston Brothers的专辑《Sweets》中的主打曲《Get On Down》，该曲延续了Isaac Hayes与Willie Hutch在1970年代初为美国犯罪电影配乐所建立的放克传统。乐队核心成员是多乐器演奏家兼制作人Sebastian Nagel与鼓手Lucas Kochbeck，二人均活跃于汉堡放克场景，参与Bacao Rhythm & Steel Band与The Mighty Mocambos等乐队。曲目以硬质碎拍鼓组、切割式吉他节奏与两管编制开场，铜管保持短促锐利的切分式点缀，中段过渡至dub式延迟处理段落，鼓底始终贯穿，构建出以break为核心的器乐结构。专辑由美国独立厂牌Colemine Records发行。整体而言，这是一篇面向单曲推荐的新闻简讯式乐评。

items.body: Clan of Xymox released the double A-side single “Broken Heart” / “Fire” on 23 September 2026 through Metropolis Records in North and South America and Trisol in Europe. It is the first new music from the darkwave and goth act since their 2024 album “Exodus”. Broken Heart / Fire by Clan of Xymox Clan of Xymox co-founder and frontman Ronny Moorings describes “Broken Heart” as “a journey through heartbreak, desire and emotional combustion.” Built on layered synth lines and a steady mid-tempo pulse, the track pairs Moorings’ vocal with lyrics about a relationship that will not fully end; his aim, he says, was “to capture the tension between losing someone and still being consumed by them.” A music video for “Broken Heart” is scheduled to go online later on 25 September, at 6pm UK time (7pm CET). No further details on “Fire”, the single’s second A-side track, were provided beyond its inclusion alongside “Broken Heart”. The single arrives as Clan of Xymox continue a run of live dates through the end of 2026, including main-stage slots at WGT-Leipzig and M’era Luna earlier in the year. Upcoming shows run from Italy in early October through Germany, Austria, Hungary, Croatia, Spain, Poland and France in November and December: 2 October – Traffic Club, Rome, Italy 3 October – Lizard Club, Naples, Italy 7 November – Gleis 9, Bochum, Germany 10 November – Strom, Munich, Germany 11 November – Chelsea, Vienna, Austria 12 November – A38, Budapest, Hungary 13 November – Culture Factory, Zagreb, Croatia 21 November – Sala Jerusalem, Valencia, Spain 27 November – Klub CK Wiatrak, Zabrze, Poland 5 December – La Laiterie, Strasbourg, France About Clan of Xymox Clan of Xymox formed in Nijmegen, the Netherlands, in 1982, when Ronny Moorings and Anka Wolbert began writing together as students. The pair relocated to Amsterdam and were joined by Pieter Nooten, and the group signed to the British label 4AD in 1985, releasing their self-titled debut album that year and “Medusa” in 1986. Their atmospheric, synth-driven post-punk sound built a cult following across the UK and mainland Europe during this period. The band moved to PolyGram’s Wing Records for “Twist of Shadows” (1989) and “Phoenix” (1991), shifting toward a more commercial synth-pop direction that incorporated alternative dance elements and brought them US chart exposure. Nooten and Wolbert left after “Phoenix”, and Moorings continued as the band’s sole constant songwriter through a run of independent releases in the early-to-mid 1990s. The group signed to Metropolis Records in North America in 1997 and to Trisol Music Group for European releases from 2009, distribution deals the band has kept ever since. The resurgence of interest in gothic and electro-industrial rock through the 1990s and 2000s gave Clan of Xymox a renewed audience, and the band has maintained a steady release and touring schedule in the decades since. Their most recent studio album, “Exodus”, arrived in mid-2024, followed by the “Blood of Christ” EP later that year and a 3CD edition of “Exodus” in early 2025. The band’s current touring line-up includes Moorings alongside Mojca Zugna, Mario Usai and Sean Winzer. “Broken Heart” / “Fire” is the group’s first new material since that run of 2024 and 2025 releases, and arrives alongside a fresh round of European festival and club dates through the end of 2026.
items._cn_summary: Clan of Xymox 发行双 A 面单曲《Broken Heart》/《Fire》，距离上一张专辑《Exodus》已有两年。主唱 Ronny Moorings 将《Broken Heart》描述为一段关于心碎、欲望与情感燃烧的旅程，以层叠合成器音色和中速节奏为骨架，歌词聚焦于一段无法彻底结束的关系。整首作品延续乐队自 4AD 时期以来的暗潮美学，合成器线条营造出冷峻氛围，人声低沉内敛。这是该乐队自 2024 年后的首支新作，发布同期宣布了横跨欧洲多国的巡演计划，涵盖意大利、德国、奥地利、匈牙利、克罗地亚、西班牙、波兰和法国等地。文章本身更接近新闻发布，缺乏深入的音乐分析与评论。

items.body: Conscience, the German electropop and synthpop project of Rüdiger Illg, releases the compilation “Uncharted Vol. 1 (The Singles 2009-2023)” on Echozone on 25 September 2026. It gathers Conscience’s single releases from that period into one set, adds one new song and three new mixes, and presents every track remastered. The label describes a second volume, “Uncharted Vol. 2”, as already in the works. Despite the plural billing Echozone sometimes gives the project, Conscience remains a one-man operation: Illg writes, plays and produces every track himself at Science2, his home studio in Leeste, Lower Saxony. He formed Conscience in 1991, but “Uncharted Vol. 1” starts its clock at 2009, not at the project’s founding. Echozone explains why: Conscience did not sign a record deal until 1998, with the “Hardware” EP, and that contract proved short-lived. Illg then signed to Echozone, whose own account of the compilation dates that move to around 2008, when “Theatre Of Deception” served as the lead single for the album “Gravity Has Gone”; Side-Line’s earlier research into the project’s Echozone catalogue had put that signing a year later, in 2009. Physical releases stopped soon after over cost, and for years Conscience issued albums and EPs with no accompanying singles at all. That changed with the 2020 album “Sentient”, after which every Conscience album has carried multiple single releases, the run “Uncharted Vol. 1” now compiles. The compilation follows the single “Explain Everything”, which Echozone issued on 28 August 2026 as an advance taste of the same collection. About Conscience Rüdiger Illg founded Conscience in August 1991, working first with a single Yamaha SY22 synthesizer, and has written, played and produced every track since under that name at Science2. He also records as Science O.C.N. and Chaos Network. The project’s first six years produced cassette-only releases traded through the tape network, followed by a first CD in 1998 and a run of CD-Rs through the early 2000s. NewEx Records picked up Conscience in 2007, and Illg signed to Echozone in 2009, a relationship that has produced the bulk of the catalogue since, including the albums “Phases³” (2025) and “Suspended In Time” (2026) and the singles and EPs “Uncharted Vol. 1” now draws its selections from. Guest vocalists across the catalogue have included Colin Angus of The Shamen and Dan Söderqvist of Twice a Man. “Uncharted Vol. 1 (The Singles 2009-2023)” is Conscience’s first compilation to collect that stretch of the catalogue in one release, with a second volume already planned.
items._cn_summary: 这篇文章本质上是一则资讯性新闻稿，介绍德国单人电子项目Conscience的首张精选合集。内容主要围绕发行背景展开：项目由Rüdiger Illg于1991年创立，所有作品在其下萨克森州的家庭工作室独立完成。合集收录2009至2023年间发行的单曲，附带一首新歌和三首新混音版本，全套经过重新母带处理。文章梳理了厂牌签约历史的时间线争议，并预告了第二卷的存在。文中未涉及任何音乐风格、声音设计、制作手法或艺术方向的实质性分析，对听感与创作意图缺乏讨论。作为面向暗潮与电子乐迷的资讯参考价值有限，更适合作为档案背景资料。

items.body: Top PickThe Ocean – Solaris (progressive post-metal) Eden should be along with a proper review sometime in the near future, but it's safe to say this first outing from the new Ocean line-up is not only a bona fide success, but also stands out as one of their strongest albums to date. The jump in quality might not come as a surprise after the snoozefest that was Holoxene (2023), but there's an argument to be made that this is the best Ocean album since genuine GOAT-contender Pelagial (2013), or even outside of it.At well over an hour and with songs and song-suites pushing the ten, fifteen and even twenty-minute mark, Solaris can be a tall order. Likewise, its expansive and layered composition works best when played in full and paying it complete attention, which is probably why I haven't listened to it nearly as much as I should have, even though we've had the promo for a month or so now. Rest assured though, that this is an album I will be playing and referring back to for years to come, and I doubt I'm alone in that assessment. Solaris by The Ocean Last Week's Most Unjustifiably Overlooked ReleaseUncle Acid and the Deadbeats – Shapes of Midnight (occult rock/metal)I didn't give this one a proper listen before posting last week's roundup, we got the promo early, but, after a quick sample I wrote it off as a good album from a band I respected but traditionally Wasn't For Me™. I should have paid more heed to Jordan's review though, because—while I'm not qualified to comment on whether this is the best Uncle Acid and the Deadbeats album—I can say its doing a whole lot more for me than any of their previous records have, or similar releases of its ilk have been lately.In comparison to the shark-jumping self-parody of the new Green Lung record, Shapes of Midnight oozes class and sincerity, along with a compelling mastery of its craft. It also rocks super hard. Along with the expected malaize of psychedelic Black Sabbath worship that pervades their sound, "Psycho on the Loose" sounds like Turbonegro covering Turbo-era Judas Priest, while "Don't Let it Control You" almost sounds like Motorhead mixed with Hellhammer, with lots of bass fills that bring to mind "Born to Be Wild". Indeed, bassist Justin Smith may well be the man of the match, delivering a Meddle-esque Pink Floyd trudge on "When Evil Wakes" and plenty of Geezer Butler-isms throughout that help make Shapes of Midnight a surprisingly vital pre-summer soundtrack as the weather starts to get warmer down under. items._cn_summary: 本期乐评聚焦多张金属类专辑的近期发行。The Ocean的《Solaris》被选为本周首推，评论者认为这是新阵容的首张正式作品，质量相较前作明显跃升，甚至可与乐队巅峰专辑《Pelagial》相提并论。专辑时长超过一小时，曲目多在十至二十分钟之间，结构宏大层次丰富，需要完整专注聆听。Uncle Acid and the Deadbeats的《Shapes of Midnight》被列为上周被忽视的佳作，评论者认为其真诚扎实、兼具迷幻色彩与硬摇滚力量，贝斯手表现尤为突出。其他提及的专辑涵盖工业黑金属、末日金属、交响金属等多种风格，但内容仅为发行列表简列。整体内容偏向传统金属领域，与实验、前卫及电子方向距离较远。

items.body: 今週も世界中の最新ジャズニュースから気になるトピックをピックアップ。 サックスという楽器が抱えてきた振れ幅を、今週は何度も思い出させられる。コルトレーン生誕100年の節目、ブランフォード・マルサリスとダイアン・リーヴスの共演、ローランド・カーク晩年の実験、そしてアンディ・シェパードとジョーイ・アレクサンダーの新作。世代も国籍も異なる5つの動きを追う。 ブランフォード・マルサリスとダイアン・リーヴス、Blue Noteでの再会 ブランフォード・マルサリス・カルテットと、ヴォーカリストのダイアン・リーヴスによるコラボレーションアルバム『Dedicated To You』が、Blue Noteからリリースされた（UK Vibe誌のレビュー）。出典で確認できるのはブラックヴァイナル仕様と限定カラー盤の存在までで、CDでの発売については出典本文に記載がないため、ここでは触れない。 ブランフォードは、弟ウィントン・マルサリスと並び称されてきたソプラノ／テナー奏者で、2002年作『Footsteps of Our Fathers』でジョン・コルトレーンの『A Love Supreme』を完全収録した経緯を持つ人物でもある。一方のダイアン・リーヴスは、10代の頃にクラーク・テリーからスタンダード・レパートリーの手ほどきを受け、1977年には「カルデラ」への参加を経て、1987年にBlue Noteと契約した最初の歌手となった歌い手である。系譜の異なる二人が同じ盤の上で言葉を交わす構図に、このアルバムの聴きどころがある。 出典：https://ukvibe.org/album_reviews/branford-marsalis-dianne-reeves ローランド・カーク、晩年の「新しさへの追求」 マルチリード奏者ローランド・カークの晩年の意欲作『Slightly Latin』が、Jazz Journal誌のコラム「JJ 09/66」で改めて取り上げられている。トロンボーン奏者ギャレット・ブラウンとの共同編成のもと、ラテン音楽の要素を取り込み、カーク特有の角ばった音色をより柔らかく響かせようとした一枚だという。 本作の背景には、1960年代半ばのジャズシーンにラテン音楽の語彙が浸透していった時期の空気がある。カークがバリトン・サックスという新たな声を得ようとしていたことも、Jazz Journalの評は伝えている。同誌はこの模索を「新しさへの絶えない追求」と評した。   出典：https://jazzjournal.co.uk/2026/09/20/jj-09-66-roland-kirk-slightly-latin アンディ・シェパード、静謐に寄せる5作目 イギリスのサックス奏者アンディ・シェパードの5作目となる新作『Salt Catchers』が、ECMから発表された（UK Jazz News）。出典によれば、本作は伝統に根ざした叙情性と、音数を絞った静けさを湛えた一枚だという。 シェパードは、ピアニストのリタ・マルコトゥッリ、ベーシストのミシェル・ベニータら長年の共演者と再びこの一枚を作り上げた。出典によれば、シェパード自身はキャラ・ブレイの「Lawns」をこれまでライブでは演奏してきたが録音してこなかったといい、今回初めて本作で録音に収めたという逸話も紹介されている。ここでは、シェパード個人がこの叙情性とどう向き合ってきたかという、小さな一点に絞って触れておく。 出典：https://ukjazznews.com/andy-sheppard-salt-catchers ジョーイ・アレクサンダー、10歳で世界に見出された歩み ジャズピアニスト、ジョーイ・アレクサンダーを取り上げた評論記事が『UK Jazz News』に掲載された。バリ島出身の彼は、2014年、10歳でニューヨークに移り住んだ直後にその演奏がウィントン・マルサリスの目に留まり、そこから国際的なジャズシーンへ足を踏み入れた経歴を持つ。 「アジア発のジャズプレイヤーが国際的に認識される時代」という大きな見立てを、今回の出典1件だけで裏づけるのは難しい。ここでは、一人のピアニストがどこから歩き出し、誰に見出されたかという個人史の線を辿るに留める。 出典：https://ukjazznews.com/joey-alexander コルトレーン生誕100年の節目に ジョン・コルトレーンが生まれてから、今年で100年になる。NPRのジャズ評論欄では、この節目に寄せた論考が公開されている（NPR、2026年9月22日）。 今回参照できた素材は表題と概要のみで、論考本文の具体的な主張までは確認できていない。テナー・サックス奏者としての革新性については、出典本文を確認できた段階で改めて扱いたい。 出典：https://www.npr.org/2026/09/22/nx-s1-5976887/marking-the-100th-birthday-of-jazz-great-john-coltrane 投稿 【ARBAN WEEKLY ／今週の話題まとめ】コルトレーン生誕100年、そしてブランフォードとリーヴスの邂逅ほか は ARBAN に最初に表示されました。

items._cn_summary: 尼日利亚歌手艾拉·斯塔尔的第三张专辑展现了她在多种风格间游走的能力。作品中融入了哀愁的阿弗罗比斯节奏、拉丁系深度浩室、中东风味的舞曲厅音乐，与莱昂·托马斯合作的合成器放克，以及与泽恩合作的钢琴 ballad。整体编排以低音声线为主角，在各种曲调中灵活穿梭。这种跨地域风格拼贴体现了当下非洲流行音乐与全球趋势的交汇，但其制作偏向主流商业路径，缺乏实验性和深度解构。作为非洲新世代女性艺人的代表，她延续了当代阿弗罗流行的商业公式，对追求前卫和地下场景的听众而言吸引力有限。

items.body: Karine Polwart has proved herself to be an exceptional talent as a singer and songwriter for many years, all the way back to her time with Malinky (the song �Thaney� was a revelation). As a solo artist she�s grown and continually expanded her horizons, coming now to Windblown , a project that began life seven years ago, when Polwart, along with sound designer and composer Pippa Murphy, was artist in residence at Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh. The album, with its stage show and book, tells the story of the garden�s oldest specimen, a Sabal palm tree ( Sabal bermudana ), which was gently felled in 2021, and contained a surprise nobody had expected. The tree is the starting point. From there, imagination runs free. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan It�s an album of voice and piano (the outstanding, sympathetic Dave Milligan), and, for all its global outlook on connections, one that�s very rooted in Scotland. You can hear it on the opening track, �Hear The Rigging/Last In Line,� where the melody becomes a slow, aching lament that would sound completely natural on the pipes. The stripped-down sound gives the songs both crafted stateliness and real intimacy. Each one is an exhalation, a memory, a celebration and exploration, with recurring phrases in the words and music acting as touchstones � or even hooks; they certainly stick in the mind. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan In many ways, this is a modest album, with piano, voice and light, judicious soundscaping. It won�t overpower with noise. Yet at the same time, it�s epic, a look at history, at the flow and grandeur of nature, and the things we all carry within us. The music, and especially Polwart�s warm, compassionate voice, envelop the listener, and makes them a participant, not an observer, but a part of the journey and the history. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan The irony arrives at the end, when the venerable old tree is down, and seeds are examined. What people for two hundred years had believed to be a Sabal bermudana turns out to be something different, a Sabal mexicana � and one of the small plants fill grow where it�s forerunner once stood. Windblown by Karine Polwart & Pippa Murphy featuring Dave Milligan Like music, plants keep to a different time � and this album/book/show give the tree the requiem it deserves, as well as hope for the future. Find the artist online. Sara Serpa - Encounters and Collisions (Review) Karine Polwart- Laws of Motion (Review) Live in the Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, 2025

items.body: In August 1819, tens of thousands of working men and women gathered in St. Peter�s Field in Manchester to hear the politician Henry Hunt speak. They were difficult times, many still out of work after the Napoleonic wars, rising prices and low wages � and always those at the bottom of the heap suffering. Hunt was a famed orator, a man on the side of the people, able to stir and inspire with his voice. Although the gathering was peaceful, the size of the crowd terrified the magistrates, who panicked and imagined an uprising. They sent in half-trained dragoons and the cavalry, who rode down, slashed and killed without compunction or compassion. In the end, 18 died and up to 700 were wounded. It was a stain on the nation, an outrage; prompting Percy Shelley, one of the poetic giants of the age, to write The Masque of Anarchy , with its famous lines: �Rise like Lions after slumber / in unvanquishable number / She your chains to earth like dew / Which in sleep had fallen on you / Ye are many - they are few.� Peterloo, as people called it, remains one of the seminal events in English working-class history, one that Sean Cooney of the Young 'Uns has revisited for this album of original songs, which is lavishly presented in a book with contemporary letters, political cartoons and illustrations to create a multimedia event. It�s ambitious, no doubt about that, and he�s selected some great talent to help � guitarist Sam Carter, the almost ubiquitous fiddler/singer Eliza Carthy, Ben Nicholls supplying background and texture on various instruments, and the Lancashire industrial ballad singer Jennifer Reid, who doubles as narrator. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid For a small ensemble, they make a powerful noise. The songs capture the feel of the day; the anticipation and excitement at the summer gathering, the joy that turns to terror and flight as the troops charge, then the bitter, mournful aftermath, voiced some powerful melodies and very well-chosen images. As a writer, Cooney often focuses on the personal in the small tales of people like �Sam Bamford� and �Mary Fildes,� while the three short pieces that comprise �The Monkey Rides The Mare� capture the bluster and arrogance of the soldiers. Peter's Field by Sean Cooney, Eliza Carthy, Sam Carter, Jennifer Reid Cooney is a persuasive singer, and on this heartfelt project, he puts plenty of emotion into his voice. Having two other outstanding vocalists alongside him makes for a wonderful triple threat. In these days when governments across the world are cracking down on protest, this stands as a sobering and very timely reminder. It�s a history lesson, yes, but the detail of the history stays in the book, while the music creates a set of songs that will resonate and remain for a long time. Find the artist online. Further reading: The Young'uns - Tiny Notes (Review) Ben Nicholls - Duets

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以1819年英国曼彻斯特圣彼得广场惨案为历史背景，通过原创歌曲重现工人阶级的抗争与悲剧。Sean Cooney邀请了多位英国民谣音乐人参与，包括小提琴手Eliza Carthy、吉他手Sam Carter等，以小型编制形成厚重的声场。歌词聚焦于Sam Bamford、Mary Fildes等普通人的故事，捕捉集会时的期盼、骑兵冲入时的惊恐，以及事后的悲恸。专辑以书籍形式发行，附有书信、政治漫画和插图，构成多媒体事件。在全球各地政府压制抗议的当下，这张作品具有现实意义。整体而言，这是一张以英国传统民谣和工业民谣为载体的历史叙事专辑，情感充沛，但风格偏向传统民谣，与实验、前卫或电子类口味匹配度较低。

items.body:
Live at Rockpalast 1999
documents a command performance at the Loreley open-air amphitheater by Malcolm �Mac� Rebennack Jr., aka Dr. John. Rockpalast is a live-music TV show broadcast since 1974 by Westdeutscher Rundfunk (WDR), the archival source for this CD-DVD package, and coincidentally a remarkable cultural institution on its own terms.
Taped at the height of Dr. John�s international popularity, backing the singer-pianist-guitarist are New Orleans stalwarts Bobby Broom (guitar), David Barard (bass), and Herman Ernest (drums), a tight quartet that projects authority and engages the crowd from start to close.
A striking UNESCO-designated World Heritage Site set, the Loreley is a slate pinnacle on a mythic horseshoe bend of the Rhine River, memorializing an enduring German literary legend both tragic and romantic. The setting is thus well-suited for Mac�s mystical spirit and lyrical style. By this stage of his career, he characterized his live show as a Mardi Gras revue with a mix of New Orleans standards and some of his most recognizable compositions.
Hence, he opens with the NOLA classic �Iko, Iko,� a half-sung, half-chanted celebration of community participation in the renowned Mardi Gras second-line street procession. Then comes the in-your-face boast �Qualified,� wherein the singer warns, �I got the power to control / I can see clean through you, blind mole / I want to tell you now, I'm qualified / You know that I'm qualified.�
Any Dr. John fan will recognize �I Walk on Guilded Splinters,� a moody, percussively insistent, foreboding expression of the Night Tripper�s immersion in �funknology� (his term), gris-gris herbology, and hoodoo incantation, punctuated with jungle growls and cries, a loopy, spooky slide whistle, and an extended psych-guitar solo: �Walk thru the fire / Fly thru the smoke / See my enemy / At the end of dey rope.�
Every piece in this well- honed set deserves considertion. Although Dr John lived for many years in Los Angeles and New York, his enduring hometown connection shows in the fond inclusion of his own �Sweet Home New Orleans� and �Goin� Back to New Orleans,� and he nods to a key influence with a funky rendering of Duke Ellington�s �I'm Gonna Go Fishin�.� Among other gems are Mac�s Top�10 hit �Right Place, Wrong Time,� and the instantly recognizable closer, Earl King�s �Big Chief,� another Mardi Gras burner.
Regarding his live performance approach, per the notes, �I always play a little bit of everything. I think that�s what music�s about: a little bit of somethin� old, somethin� in the middle, somethin� new, and somethin� as yet uncreated.�
Dr John's�s longtime fans will welcome this archival gem, which also is a solid introduction for any late comers to the party. Surmounting the barriers of language and culture, the power of
At the Rockpalast
is also evident in the enthusiastic audience response. As he declares, �If you�re gonna get off on somethin� you don�t need to know nothin� about it. Music is a universal language.�

items._cn_summary: 这张专辑以表面柔和、内在复杂的爵士风格为特点，三十年前的乐评人曾指出其中隐藏的精致构思。Jeff Lorber 作为融合爵士的代表人物，作品在流畅旋律之下埋藏着更为深邃的和声与编排细节，试图在商业可听性与艺术深度之间寻求平衡。专辑延续了九十年代融合爵士的传统语汇，强调键盘主导的旋律线条与节拍的律动感。然而，相较于同时代更具突破性的学院派爵士或自由即兴作品，这张专辑整体仍偏向主流融合范畴，其复杂更多体现在编曲层面而非对声音边界的探索。对于追求前卫实验语境的听众而言，此作可能缺乏足够的冒险性；但若从融合爵士自身脉络审视，则展现出一种克制而老练的美学取向。

items.body: Norwegian electro-industrial project TAZER release the single and video “Rest in Beatz” on Hellektrokution Records. The track is out now, backed by an official music video. Watch TAZER’s ‘Rest in Beatz’ video Hellektrokution Records describes the track as “built around driving electronic rhythms, distorted synthesizers and an intense industrial atmosphere.” “Rest in Beatz” is also streaming on Spotify. About TAZER TAZER is a Norwegian electro-industrial trio made up of Calico InHell, Drumnibal and Oni X01, who record under the aliases CALICO, DRUMNIBAL and ONI-X01. The project formed in 2024 around the EP “9001 Volts” and issued its debut single, “A Razor Can Slit, A Tazer Can Kill”, in November 2024. TAZER returned in October 2025 with a video for “I Put a Spell on You” for Halloween. Five further tracks written over the following two years joined five songs from “9001 Volts” to form the ten-track debut album “Taze Is The Rule,” released through Hellektrokution Records on 30 April 2026. The label followed it with the single “Raise The Voltage” in May 2026. In an August 2026 Side-Line interview, Oni X01 said “Taze Is The Rule” is “our manifesto, our creed, and our undeniable truth,” and described the album’s sound as a mix of metal and EBM elements influenced by Rammstein and Combichrist. “Rest in Beatz” is TAZER’s newest single and video, released now on Hellektrokution Records.
items._cn_summary: 本文为挪威电工业三人组TAZER单曲《Rest in Beatz》的新闻发布稿。作品以电子鼓机节奏、失真合成器音色与工业化氛围为核心，乐队自述音乐取向混合金属与EBM元素，并提及Rammstein与Combichrist为影响来源。文章主体为厂牌宣传与乐队背景介绍，并未对音乐本体展开任何评论性分析，缺乏对声音设计、作曲结构或艺术立场的深入评述。作为一篇典型的厂牌通稿，内容以事实陈述为主，信息密度有限，对作品的艺术价值判断无法形成有效依据。

items.body: ALEO and Menny Flores released “No Voy a Estar” on Mania Records on 18 September 2026. The synth pop single is sung in Spanish over 80s-style synthesizers and a prominent bassline, and marks the pair’s second collaboration on the label after the earlier single “Gracias.” “No Voy a Estar” opens on the line “no voy a estar, no me esperes” (“I won’t be there, don’t wait for me”) turns on the moment late-night calls and unfulfilled promises stop working; rather than dwell on the breakup, the song moves past it. Midway through, the arrangement tightens and Flores’ delivery shifts from melodic verses into a faster, more conversational rhythmic pattern. ALEO produced the track and shares songwriting credit with Menny Flores. About ALEO ALEO is a Grammy-winning producer, songwriter and multi-instrumentalist based in Los Angeles who runs the independent label Mania Records. His production and writing credits include work with Juanes, Young Thug, Swae Lee, Gunna, Lil Baby and A.CHAL, among others. On Mania Records, ALEO has also produced for Parallel 33, including the single “Sowe”, released in June 2026. “No Voy a Estar” is his second single this year alongside Menny Flores, following “Gracias,” and continues a run of ALEO-produced Mania Records releases through the second half of 2026.

items.body: Mesh will release the mini-album “Fallen Angel” on Dependent Records on 27 November 2026. The British duo of Mark Hockings and Richard Silverthorn describe the nine-track record as an addendum to this year’s album “The Truth Doesn’t Matter” rather than the start of a new chapter, built from songs that grew out of writing sessions the pair started after touring behind that record. The label had asked for a fourth single from “The Truth Doesn’t Matter”; Hockings and Silverthorn instead wrote enough new material for close to half an album of additional songs. “Fallen Angel” combines four newly written tracks with remixes and a live recording, offering what the band calls a deeper dive into the themes of “The Truth Doesn’t Matter”. Pre-orders for “Fallen Angel” open on 24 September, the same day the mini-album’s fourth single from that campaign, “Trying to Save You”, arrives on streaming platforms in a mix by Olaf Wollschläger. The title track follows as a single on 21 October with a new music video featuring the band, ahead of the full CD and vinyl release on 27 November. The tracklist: Fallen Angel Protect Your Neck Not This Time The Meeting of the Broken Tilt Trying to Save You (single mix) The Truth Doesn’t Matter (live, recorded on this tour) Fallen Angel (extended version) Trying to Save You (remix) “Fallen Angel”, “Protect Your Neck”, “Not This Time” and “The Meeting of the Broken” are entirely new songs; “Tilt” receives its first physical release. Mark Hockings and Richard Silverthorn wrote and recorded all tracks and produced the mini-album with Vaughn George on live keyboards and Sean Suleman on live drums; it was recorded at Mesh HQ and The Summerhouse in Bristol, mixed by Olaf Wollschläger and Mesh at Cottonbeat Studio in Burscheid, Germany, with additional mastering by Wollschläger. Mark Hockings supplied the artwork and photography, with additional artwork, editing and layout by Nico Janse van Rensburg. “Fallen Angel” will be released as a jewel case CD, a limited clear vinyl LP capped at 500 copies, and a standard black vinyl LP; the CD and a KitAlbum Tour Edition will be available at Mesh’s live shows roughly six weeks ahead of the wider release. Distribution runs through SPKR. At least two of the new songs will be played live starting with Mesh’s show in Krefeld, Germany, on 1 October. The band’s confirmed live dates through November: 1 October 2026 – Krefeld, Germany – Kulturfabrik 2 October 2026 – Braunschweig, Germany – Westand 3 October 2026 – Dresden, Germany – Reithalle Strasse E 4 October 2026 – Berlin, Germany – Kesselhaus 5 November 2026 – Łódź, Poland – Klub Scenografia 6 November 2026 – Halle/Saale, Germany – Capitol 7 November 2026 – Liberec, Czech Republic – Dům Kultury Liberec (Sever Synth Festival) Hockings and Silverthorn also confirmed that “Looking Skyward” is set to return on red vinyl “very, very soon”, and that “Who Watches Over Me?” will receive a 25th-anniversary reissue in 2027 as an art book edition with refreshed artwork, following the return of its rights from Sony Music; that album will also return to streaming platforms next year. The details emerged during a Zoom Q&A with Hockings and Silverthorn on 22 September, which Mesh had previously teased as previewing an “unusual release”. About Mesh Mesh formed in 1991 in the UK when vocalist and guitarist Mark Hockings and keyboard player and vocalist Richard Silverthorn began writing together, later joined by keyboardist Neil Taylor. The band released the “Fragile” EP in 1994 and its debut album, “In This Place Forever”, in 1996, followed by “The Point at Which It Falls Apart” in 1999, reissued in a 25th-anniversary edition in 2024. The major-label release “Who Watches Over Me?” in 2002 widened the band’s European audience, especially in Germany, and 2006’s “We Collide” was produced with former Depeche Mode collaborator Gareth Jones. “Automation Baby” (2013) reached number 33 on the German album chart, and “Looking Skyward” (2016) climbed to number 12 there. Mesh continued as the core duo of Hockings and Silverthorn, touring with drummer Sean Suleman and additional live keyboard players, and added Vaughn George to the live lineup in April 2023. Hockings also records solo as Blackcarburning, releasing the album “Watching Sleepers” and the EP “Divide Us”. Mesh’s most recent album, “The Truth Doesn’t Matter”, arrived in 2026 on Dependent Records, preceded by the singles “Exile”, “Hey Stranger” and “This World” and followed by a European tour; “Fallen Angel”, out 27 November 2026, extends that album cycle with new songs, remixes and a live recording.
items._cn_summary: 这是英国双人组合 Mesh 在 Dependent Records 旗下发行的迷你专辑《Fallen Angel》的曲目与发行信息公告。专辑定位为 2026 年正式专辑《The Truth Doesn't Matter》的补充延伸，收录四首新曲、一首实体首发的旧作、一首现场录音、两首混音与延伸版本。制作由乐队成员 Mark Hockings 与 Richard Silverthorn 完成，混音由 Olaf Wollschläger 操刀，录制于布里斯托尔的工作室。发行形式涵盖塑料盒 CD、限量 500 张的透明黑胶及标准黑胶，巡演版将于实体店提前六周发售。公告附带德国与波兰的巡演日程。作为纯新闻稿件，内容仅陈述发行事实，缺乏任何音乐性描述或评论性分析。

items.body: Demonwarp released “Viral Empire” on Re:Mission Entertainment on 25 September 2026. The album is Demonwarp’s third full-length, running ten original tracks of industrial and EBM rhythm work layered with dark synth and metal-edged electronics, its lyrics turning on surveillance, corruption, artificial intelligence and resistance to power. Viral Empire by Demonwarp Two tracks were released as singles ahead of the album: “Protocol Obey” and “Spreading The Flames.” “Viral Empire” adds three remixes of those singles to close out its thirteen-track sequence: Frontal Boundary reworks “Protocol Obey,” while Dawn Of Ashes and Dread Risks each contribute separate versions of “Spreading The Flames.” Demonwarp handled all production and vocals on the album; Kristof Bathory mastered it, and KGM Studio supplied the cover art. Pre-orders opened on 4 September ahead of the 25 September release. The first pressing is a limited run of 100 digipak CDs, alongside the full digital release on Bandcamp. “Viral Empire” follows 2024’s “Dominion,” Demonwarp’s second album, which featured Jenna Cogan on vocals. About Demonwarp Demonwarp began self-releasing music in 2022 with the single “Devil’s Sunset” and the ten-track album “In The Night,” followed the same year by the singles “Relent” and “Lust Lies In Betrayal.” Further self-released singles, “Just Ashes,” “Scream At The Gates,” “Onikiri” and “Fading Flesh,” followed through 2023. Demonwarp’s second album, “Dominion,” arrived in September 2024 with Jenna Cogan featured on vocals. “Viral Empire,” Demonwarp’s third full-length, arrived on 25 September 2026 through Re:Mission Entertainment, preceded by the singles “Protocol Obey” and “Spreading The Flames” and the remixes of both that close the new album.

items.body:
Tiny Sun creates tiny songs that give off light and heat well out of proportion to their size. Composed, performed, and produced by Martina Sorbara, Jonathan Goldsmith, and Don Rooke, the record is vaguely Americana, with plucked guitars and ukuleles, chiming keyboards, and the lonesome slide of the guitar.
Vanishment
contains eighteen sparkling miniatures - that take a scant 34 minutes to negotiate - notable for their economy of arrangement and the subtle directness of the lyrics. The tracks glow with Martina�s clear, high, and sometimes fragile voice.
The songs are about loss: lost love, lost confidence, but sometimes about resignation to the enigmatic quirks of the world. The tone of wry fatalism mirrors the fact that this project is the work of many years of collaboration and email exchanges while the trio pursued their musical day jobs. Jonathan Goldsmith is an award-winning composer for television and film, Don Rooke fronts the Toronto roots band The Henrys, and Martina Sorbara is known for folk, electropop, and her band Dragonette.
Kerosene Madrigal
The range of backgrounds leads to many styles, and the record betrays interesting influences. The opening track, �Kerosene Madrigal,� is a sort of miner�s blues reminiscent of Michelle Shocked. The soul-country of �Imagined Love� reminded me of fellow Torontonians Cowboy Junkies, especially the sweet organ. The stoic and twangy �Don�t Fault the Stars for Falling� could have been a Dolly Parton tune.
A Grand Expanse
�A Grand Expanse� has a more ambitious arrangement.  It sounds like the end-credits song from a long-ago film we only vaguely remember. It says everything it needs to in one minute and twenty seconds and exactly 38 words. It is quintessential Tiny Sun.
The entire recording feels like music from a dream, and since no one knows exactly what dream music sounds like, this could be it.
Berceuse
Tiny Sun will perform the entire album at Toronto�s Koerner Hall on May 14, 2026.

items._cn_summary: Tiny Sun由三位加拿大音乐人远程合作完成，这张专辑收录十八首短小精致的民谣小品，总时长仅三十四分钟。乐器以拨弦吉他、尤克里里、滑音吉他与键盘为主，编曲极度精简，歌词直白且微妙。歌曲主题围绕失落展开，包括失去的爱情、信心以及对世界无常的宿命式接受。整体风格在美式民谣的框架内融合乡村布鲁斯、灵魂乡村与电影配乐质感，呈现出梦境般朦胧的氛围。唱腔清亮高亢，偶尔流露脆弱质感。虽然创作者背景横跨电视配乐、实验民谣与电子流行，但成品并未朝向实验或跨界融合方向探索，而是停留在温暖内省的民谣谱系内。对于偏好实验、前卫与电子声响的听众而言，这张作品的音乐语言过于传统与抒情。
